Do Not Download - EVER. I downloaded this app while attempting to set up a small camera my children received as a gift. Unfortunately, this was not the correct app for the product, and I did not realize I was authorizing a $79.99 annual subscription.

I never created an account, never meaningfully used the service, and contacted the developer immediately after discovering the charge. I was told that only Apple could issue a refund. After multiple discussions with Apple, I was informed that Apple had contacted the developer regarding the refund request and that the developer declined to approve a refund.

As a result, I was charged $79.99 for a service I never used and never intended to purchase. While I understand subscription policies exist, this outcome feels unfair given the mistaken download, lack of account registration, lack of usage, and immediate effort to resolve the issue.

As a California consumer, this experience raises concerns about transparency and customer expectations surrounding subscription purchases and refunds. 

I hope the developer reconsiders its position and provides a refund. Until then, I would encourage potential users to carefully review any subscription terms before downloading.

Apple used to be customer first - they are now revenue first. The Google Pixel is looking more appealing. 

I will be filing complaints as my children are shocked how unfair. If you’ve had a similar experience see below.

A Stunning Leap Forward in Makeup Editing Flawless, Fearless, and Worth Every Pixel. This is the best makeup editor I’ve used a rare blend of technical mastery and editorial taste that turns raw footage into magazine-ready moments with unapologetic confidence.

What it does brilliantly

• Makeup transformations: realistic skin texture, believable contouring, and color matching that never reads as artificial.
• Outfit swaps: seamless garment transitions that preserve folds, skin continuity, and movement.
• Video enhancements: frame-by-frame fidelity that keeps expressions and motion intact while applying complex edits.
• Speed + control: powerful defaults that look amazing out of the box, with granular sliders for those who want to finesse every pixel.
• Creative features: mood lighting, selective glamour boosts, and layered looks that let you build editorial narratives, not just quick fixes.


Why it stands out

Every edit feels intentional. The tool doesn’t just slap on a filter it understands anatomy, costume continuity, and how light behaves across skin and fabric. Results read as crafted artistry, not algorithmic band-aids. The UI respects both fast workflows and deep, iterative refinement.

The sting

It’s prohibitively expensive. I only wish I could afford it. The price puts this level of polish out of reach for many independent creators and small teams who would benefit most from its capabilities.

Verdict

If budget is no barrier, this is a must-have for anyone serious about pro-level beauty and fashion edits. For everyone else, follow its updates and demos closely it’s setting the standard and will likely shape what we expect from every makeup editor going forward.

Rating

4 out of 5 for creative power, 3 out of 5 for accessibility because of the price.
